text:
ana: hey team, i'm starting oncall next week and want to preflight everything. couple quick asks: who is my week-1 buddy, how do i sanity-test pager delivery from my laptop, and where's the shortest 'first shift' runbook? trying to avoid surprises.
ben: welcome ana :wave: i'm your buddy for week 1. add me on PD (ben@redwood.com). i'll do the initial handoff and pair on the first incident.
tara: runbooks: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/oncall/first-shift-onepager — it's a 1-page checklist. key bits: PD contact methods, escalation times, and triage snippet.
nana: small note: run that one-pager before your first night.
nana: thanks! how do i trigger a local pager test?
ben: VPN + SSO required. run: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://ops-api.redwood.internal/test_alert -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"user":"ana","mode":"push"}'
```
opsbot: OpsBot: queued test alert for ana. Delivering in ~20s. Check PD and phone.
nana: i ran it and got 401. SSO looks fine.
tara: 401 usually token mismatch. try `aws sso login` or refresh your corp SSO session. also check ~/.redwood/session for a current id_token.
nana: ok reran after sso login and got 200; push arrived: "TEST ALERT  SIMULATION". PD shows source: ops-sim and device: iphone. good.
ben: perfect. next: schedule — we have a 30m dry-run tomorrow 10am PT. join Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/222333444. we'll simulate a DB timeout and walk triage + escalation.
nana: two final Qs: 1) who to page for infra vs db incidents? 2) what's the expected ack for a P1 outside business hours?
tara: infra -> @infra-oncall, db -> @db-owner (list in runbook). P1 ack target is 5m business hours, 10m nights/weekends. if no ack escalate to eng-sre after the ack window.
infra-bot: infra-bot: added ana to oncall calendar and shadow rotation. Contact methods check: push=true, sms=true, email=true.
nana: awesome. one last paranoid question: any docs about what NOT to do on suspected data exposure? want to avoid messing up chain of custody.
ben: yes — data-leak quick rules are in the runbooks link. TL;DR: do NOT restart services, do NOT request engineers delete logs, snapshot and notify security/legal.
opsbot: OpsBot: test log 1835009999 - delivered to ana via push; status: delivered; ack: none.
nana: thanks everyone 44d feeling much better about the rotation. i'll join the dry-run and DM if i hit another curl issue.
